`tickServer(canProcess, hasInput)`: no input -> `stopProcessing`; recipe lookup only when input; `couldCraftLastTick = canCraft(recipe)`; if `canProcess && couldCraft` then `tryStartProcessing(); progress++; tryFinishProcessing(recipe)` else `stopProcessing()`
rows.evidence: EV=NOT EXECUTED (Rust unit tests exist for progress/stop; no Java oracle)

rows.behaviour: `tryFinishProcessing` fires at `progress >= totalTime`, resets `progress=0`, `totalTime=getTotalTime()`, then `craft`, then `sendBlockUpdated` — no `setChanged()` there
`tryStartProcessing` sets `isProcessing=true` and sends block update only when `progress == 0`
`stopProcessing` only mutates/notifies if `progress != 0 \|\| isProcessing`; resets `progress` but **keeps** `couldCraftLastTick` when already idle (Java quirk — keep it)
`canCraft`: `assemble(input)` empty -> false; else dry-run insert into output and require *whole* stack fits
`craft`: insert assembled into output first; if any remainder -> false; then extract exactly `getIngredientCount(recipe)` from slot 0; commit only if both succeed (atomic, no dupe/void)
`getTotalTime` = recipe time or `getDefaultCraftingTime()` when no level/recipe
`progressPercent = clamp(progress*100/totalTime, 0, 100)`, 0 when `totalTime <= 0` (no div-by-zero)
`onInputItemChanged` sets `totalTime=getTotalTime()`, `progress=0`
`alreadyHasInput` early-out in `canProcess(ItemStack)` via `ItemStack.isSameItemSameComponents`
save/load: `progress`, `totalTime`, `isProcessing`, `couldCraftLastTick` persist across save/reload
network sync writes only `isProcessing`
`LevelAwareCachedCheck`/`LevelAwareRecipeCheck` caching semantics (cache invalidation on input change)
`SettableItemStorage` / `MonitoredItemStackHandler` / `DynamicOneOutputSlotItemHandlerBehaviour` output-slot sizing
`HeatConsumerBehaviour.isHeated` 20-tick cache, provider-below priority, receiver fallback, `LIT` update + `setChanged` on transition only
`DefaultHeatReceiver`: `isHotUntil` serialized, `readyToReceive`, `setHotUntil`
`CraftingHeatReceiver.readyToReceive` (only accepts heat while not already processing)
Pyromantic brazier: 1-slot inventory accepting only `COOKING_FUEL` with `burnTime > 0` (26.3 item component, resolved via empty loot context)
Brazier tick: decrement `remainingLitTime` when lit; relight from fuel; consume exactly 1 fuel incl. crafting remainder; sync `LIT` blockstate; `setChanged` when transitioned
Brazier `remainingLitTime` is saved as `short` (`getShortOr`), inventory synced to clients
